summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, announcing completion of its acquisition of LightSolver Ltd., an Israeli photonic computing firm. The deal closed September 3, 2026, under a Share Purchase Agreement dated August 29, 2026. Consideration was equity-centric: upfront ordinary shares, pre-funded warrants, and a $5 million investment in LightSolver, plus milestone-based warrants tied to technological and commercial goals. CollPlant enters the high-performance computing/photonics sector while continuing regenerative medicine operations. No price-per-share or premium was disclosed. The press release quotes executives from both companies; no advisors or board recommendation were mentioned. Watch for milestone warrant exercises and LightSolver's commercialization progress.
